title: Windows Performance Optimization
description: Fine-tune Windows settings to maximize your HP OMEN laptop performance for gaming, productivity, and everyday use.

prerequisites.title: Before You Start
items: Create a system restore point before making performance tweaks
This allows you to easily revert changes if something doesn't work as expected

steps.title: Power Plan Configuration
steps.content:
Create a custom high-performance power plan for maximum performance.

**Steps:**
1. Right-click Start → "Power Options" → "Additional power settings"
2. Click "Create a power plan" → Select "High performance" as base
3. Click "Change advanced power settings" and customize:

**Recommended Settings:**
• Processor power management: Min 5%, Max 100%
• PCI Express Link State Power Management: Off
• USB selective suspend: Disabled
• Graphics settings: Maximum performance

infoBox.title: Battery Impact
infoBox.content: High-performance power plans significantly reduce battery life. Use "Balanced" mode when on battery and switch to "High Performance" when plugged in.

steps.title: Startup Optimization
steps.content:
Reduce boot time and free up system resources by managing startup applications.

**Method 1: Task Manager**
1. Press Ctrl + Shift + Esc
2. Click "Startup" tab
3. Right-click unwanted apps → "Disable"

**Method 2: Settings App**
1. Open Settings → Apps → Startup
2. Toggle off apps you don't need

**Recommended Apps to Keep Enabled:**
✓ OMEN Gaming Hub
✓ HP Support Assistant
✓ Windows Security
✓ Audio drivers (Realtek/Bang & Olufsen)
✓ Graphics driver tools (if needed)
✓ Your preferred cloud sync

steps.title: Background Apps Management
steps.content:
Disable unnecessary background apps to free up resources.

**Steps:**
1. Settings → Privacy → Background apps (Windows 10) or Settings → Apps → Installed apps → App settings (Windows 11)

2. Disable unnecessary apps:
• Calculator, Calendar, Camera
• Mail & Calendar (if not using)
• Maps, People, Phone Link
• Weather, Widgets, Xbox services (if not gaming)

infoBox.title: Pro Tip
infoBox.content: Keep Xbox Game Bar and related Xbox services enabled if you use them for screenshots, recordings, or Game Pass gaming.

steps.title: Memory Optimization
steps.content:
Configure virtual memory for optimal performance.

**Steps:**
1. Right-click Start → System → Advanced system settings → Advanced tab
2. Performance Settings → Advanced → Virtual memory → Change
3. Uncheck "Automatically manage"
4. Select system drive and set custom size

**Recommended Page File Sizes:**
• 8 GB RAM: Initial 4096 MB, Max 8192 MB
• 16 GB RAM: Initial 8192 MB, Max 16384 MB
• 32 GB+ RAM: System Managed (automatic)

steps.title: Storage Cleanup & Optimization
steps.content:
Keep your storage clean for optimal performance.

**Disk Cleanup:**
1. Press Win + R
2. Type "cleanmgr"
3. Select drive and check all boxes
4. Click "Clean up system files"
5. Select Windows Update Cleanup, Temp files

**Storage Sense:**
1. Settings → System → Storage
2. Enable "Storage Sense"
3. Configure cleanup schedule
4. Set temp file deletion to 1 day
5. Enable Recycle Bin auto-cleanup

infoBox.title: Before Cleanup
infoBox.content: Review files before deleting. The "Downloads" folder cleanup can remove files you may need. Exclude it from automatic cleanup or move important files first.

steps.title: Visual Effects Optimization
steps.content:
Reduce Windows visual effects for better performance.

**Steps:**
1. Right-click Start → System → Advanced system settings → Advanced → Performance Settings
2. Select "Custom" and enable only these for best balance:
✓ Show thumbnails instead of icons
✓ Smooth edges of screen fonts
✓ Use visual styles on windows and buttons
Everything else → OFF

**Additional Visual Tweaks:**
• Disable Transparency: Settings → Personalization → Colors → Transparency effects OFF
• Disable Animations: Settings → Accessibility → Visual effects → Animation effects OFF
• Reduce Motion: Settings → Accessibility → Motion → OFF

steps.title: Quick Optimization Checklist
steps.content:
Use this checklist to ensure you've covered all optimizations:

☐ Create High Performance power plan
☐ Disable unnecessary startup apps
☐ Configure virtual memory
☐ Run Disk Cleanup
☐ Enable Storage Sense
☐ Adjust visual effects
☐ Disable background apps
☐ Disable transparency effects

infoBox.title: Expected Results
infoBox.content: After applying these optimizations, you should see faster boot times, improved gaming performance, and smoother overall system responsiveness.
